font.japaneseWindows.text: This computer has no font that can show Japanese subtitles (tried Yu Gothic, Meiryo, MS Gothic), so burned-in Japanese would turn into empty boxes. Install a Japanese font (such as Yu Gothic or Meiryo) in "Settings > Personalization > Fonts", or add the Japanese supplemental fonts in "Settings > System > Optional features", then try again. Subtitle files (SRT, ASS) aren't affected, and you can still export them.

encoder.windows.before: 這台電腦的 Windows 沒有 H.264 編碼器，無法把字幕燒進影片。請到「設定 > 系統 > 選用功能」安裝「媒體功能套件」（Windows N 或 KN 版才需要），或執行 Windows Update 後再試。字幕檔（SRT、ASS）不受影響，仍可匯出。
encoder.windows.text: Windows on this computer has no H.264 encoder, so the subtitles can't be burned into the video. In "Settings > System > Optional features", install "Media Feature Pack" (only Windows N and KN editions need it), or run Windows Update, then try again. Subtitle files (SRT, ASS) aren't affected, and you can still export them.

localBuild.before: whispercpp 在這個平台沒有現成的程式可以下載，要在這台電腦上自己編譯一次：請在專案資料夾執行 scripts/mac/build_whisper_cli.sh（步驟見 docs/MACOS.md）。編譯好的 whisper-cli 會放在 /vst-data/runtimes/whispercpp-b5454-macos-metal，放在 PATH 上也找得到。
localBuild.text: There's no ready-made whispercpp program to download for this platform, so you need to build it once on this computer. In the project folder, run scripts/mac/build_whisper_cli.sh (the steps are in docs/MACOS.md). The built whisper-cli goes in /vst-data/runtimes/whispercpp-b5454-macos-metal. The app also finds it on your PATH.

notices.message: There's no ready-made whispercpp program to download for this platform, so you need to build it once on this computer. In the project folder, run scripts/mac/build_whisper_cli.sh (the steps are in docs/MACOS.md). The built whisper-cli goes in /vst-data/runtimes/whispercpp-b5454-macos-metal. The app also finds it on your PATH.

foundElsewhere.before: whisper-cli 是在 /opt/homebrew/bin 找到的，不在 App 的執行檔資料夾（/vst-data/runtimes/whispercpp-b5454-macos-metal）裡，所以 App 沒有刪它。要移除請自己處理（用 Homebrew 裝的就用 brew uninstall）。
foundElsewhere.text: The app didn't delete whisper-cli: it was found in /opt/homebrew/bin, not in the app's runtimes folder (/vst-data/runtimes/whispercpp-b5454-macos-metal). To remove it, do that yourself (if you installed it with Homebrew, use brew uninstall).

notices.message: The app didn't delete whisper-cli: it was found in /opt/homebrew/bin, not in the app's runtimes folder (/vst-data/runtimes/whispercpp-b5454-macos-metal). To remove it, do that yourself (if you installed it with Homebrew, use brew uninstall).
